title: Yelp Ads | Use Yelp's advertising solutions to reach more customers

facts.fact: Yelp's vendor page claims advertisers can get 4x more leads for their business with Yelp Ads.
facts.quote: Get 4x more leads for your business with Yelp Ads.

facts.fact: Yelp's vendor page states that over half a million businesses advertise on Yelp.
facts.quote: Over half a million businesses advertise on Yelp.

facts.fact: Yelp's vendor page says Yelp Ads can be bought with spend as little as $5 per day on average.
facts.quote: Spend as little as $5/day on average. You can also adjust your budget or pause your ad anytime.

facts.fact: Yelp's vendor page says Yelp Ads reach millions of customers searching on and off Yelp.
facts.quote: advertise your business information, service offerings, and more to millions of customers searching on and off Yelp.

facts.fact: Yelp's vendor page says a Yelp Ad is featured in the 'Sponsored Results' sections above and below organic search results and on competitor pages.
facts.quote: Your ad will be featured in key locations on the site in the "Sponsored Results" sections (which are above and below the organic search results) and on competitor pages.

facts.fact: Yelp Ads can be targeted by location and keyword so the ad is shown only to the business's most likely customers, according to Yelp's vendor page.
facts.quote: Target by location and keyword so that your ad is only shown to your most likely customers.

facts.fact: Yelp's Spotlight Ads are auto-play videos in national, high-visibility placements across the Yelp app, per Yelp's page.
facts.quote: Grab attention at scale with auto-play videos in national, high-visibility placements across the Yelp app.

facts.fact: Yelp's page says large businesses get access to additional ad products plus a dedicated account team to strategize, build, and optimize every campaign.
facts.quote: In addition to Yelp Ads, large businesses get access to these ad products—plus a dedicated account team to strategize, build, and optimize every campaign.
